descriptions.preferred: 黑色蕾丝是一款直立生长的品种。早春呈深红色，随着春天光照的增多会逐渐变成暗紫红色。夏天气温升高变成青铜色。秋天的变成橙红色。7叶裂叶型很细，开裂至叶基部边缘有不规则的锯齿，所以外观看上去很像羽毛。成年树高约3米。

sources.title: 黑色蕾丝Acer Palmatum 'Black Lace'
sources.description: 黑色蕾丝是一款直立生长的品种。早春呈深红色，随着春天光照的增多会逐渐变成暗紫红色。夏天气温升高变成青铜色。秋天的变成橙红色。7叶裂叶型很细，开裂至叶基部边缘有不规则的锯齿，所以外观看上去很像羽毛。成年树高约3米。

rhs.description: Small, upright, deciduous shrubby tree to about 3m tall, with feathery, deeply cut, dark reddish-purple leaves divided into 5 lobes, turning bronze-green by late summer then bright orange and red in autumn. Inconspicuous red-purple flowers in spring may be followed by winged, purple fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Patio/Container Plants
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this matsumurae group are deeply divided to around three quarters of the leaf with coarsely-toothed edges and narrow, pointed lobes

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 黑色蕾丝是一款直立生长的品种。早春呈深红色，随着春天光照的增多会逐渐变成暗紫红色。夏天气温升高变成青铜色。秋天的变成橙红色。7叶裂叶型很细，开裂至叶基部边缘有不规则的锯齿，所以外观看上去很像羽毛。成年树高约3米。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、露台/容器栽培
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 matsumurae 组的槭树，叶片深裂约达叶片的四分之三，叶缘具粗齿，裂片狭长且先端尖。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

rhs_zh.description: 小型、直立、落叶性灌木状小乔木，高约 3 米。叶片羽毛状、深裂、暗红紫色，分为 5 裂，至夏末转为铜绿色，秋季再变为鲜橙色和红色。春季可开不显眼的红紫色小花，之后可能结带翅的紫色果实。
